profile.background: A veteran guild operative who leads covert missions. She earned her reputation through precision, patience, and an unshakable composure under fire.
profile.speakingStyle: Direct, measured, rarely wastes words. Speaks with quiet authority.

appearance.notableFeatures: A thin scar along her left jaw from an old mission
